metadata.title: BAS District
metadata.description: An isometric city of citizen NFTs, shown with mock data.

city.eventBody: Craft fixes the generator, Bond calms the crowd, Insight finds the cause.
city.blockedMessage: {name} cannot enter {district} yet. It opens at {rule}.
city.notOwnedMessage: Only citizens you own follow your taps. Pick one under My citizens.

profile.title: CITIZEN PROFILE
profile.talkMessage: Only the owner can talk to a citizen.
profile.missing: No citizen has this number yet. Citizens appear here once they are minted.

chat.title: TALK TO {name}
chat.aiNote: {name} is an AI character, not a real person. It cannot trade, send tokens or sign anything for you.
chat.breakReminder: You have been talking for over an hour. Maybe take a short break?
chat.connect: Connect your wallet to talk to {name}.
chat.previewOnly: Talking to citizens opens when the district runs on the live network.
chat.unreachable: Chat cannot be reached right now.
chat.off: Chat is switched off right now.
chat.memoryNothing: Nothing about you yet. Only short notes are kept, never full conversations.
chat.memoryPrivate: Only you can see these notes. They stay with you if {name} is sold.
chat.forgot: {name} no longer remembers what you told it.

notices.disabled: Chat is switched off right now. Your message was not sent.
notices.budget: Chat is resting for today. Try again tomorrow. Your message was not counted.
notices.quota: {name} has talked enough for today. Chat opens again in {time}.
notices.timeout: {name} did not answer in time. Your message was not counted, so you can send it again.
notices.invalid: {name} could not find the words. Your message was not counted, so you can send it again.
notices.error: {name} could not answer just now. Your message was not counted, so you can send it again.
notices.busy: Your last message is still being answered. Give it a moment.
notices.declined: {name} would rather not talk about that.
notices.not-owner: Only the current owner can talk to this citizen.
notices.citizen-not-found: This citizen is not ready to talk yet.
notices.unauthorized: Sign in with your wallet again to keep talking.
notices.rate-limited: That was a lot of messages at once. Wait a moment.
notices.too-long: That message is too long. Keep it under {max} characters.
notices.bad-request: That message could not be sent.
notices.declinedSignIn: The wallet request was closed, so chat did not start.
notices.unavailable: Chat cannot be reached right now. Your message was not counted.

journey.title: YOUR PATH
journey.subtitle: {name} · Tier {tier} of 3
journey.ladderNote: A stat at 3, 6 and 10 reaches Tier 1, 2 and 3.
journey.bracketNote: The bracket follows the highest stat: {rookie} 0–3 · {skilled} 4–6 · {elite} 7–9 · {master} 10.

next.start: Take the mission "{mission}" to earn one {stat} credit.
next.trainTier: Train {stat} from {from} to {to} and reach Tier {tier}.
next.earnTokens: {name} holds a {stat} credit, but the wallet needs {missing} {symbol} more to train it.
next.waitDaily: {name} finished all {max} missions today. Missions open again tomorrow.
next.waitCooldown: {name} finished every mission that gives a credit today. They open again tomorrow.
next.idle: No mission is open for {name} right now. A district event may start soon.
next.complete: Every stat is at 10. {name} can now compete for the Master bracket.
next.notOwner: {name} belongs to another player, so there is no path to follow.

journey.tierUpMaster: {name} now competes in the Master bracket.
journey.paceOne: About 1 day to Tier {tier} through {stat}: one mission a day gives one credit.
journey.paceMany: About {days} days to Tier {tier} through {stat}: one mission a day gives one credit.

missions.title: MISSION BOARD
missions.subtitle: Central Plaza
missions.note: Credits from missions are the only way to train
missions.needCitizen: Take this mission with a citizen of your own.
missions.rewardEvent: A credit for each task, plus the event title
missions.rewardNote: Goes to {name} only and cannot be traded. One credit plus {cost} {symbol} trains {stat} {from} → {to}.
missions.verified: The mission server checks each step, then co-signs the credit on chain.
missions.rewardReadyOne: 1 {stat} credit is ready to spend in Training.
missions.rewardReadyMany: {count} {stat} credits are ready to spend in Training.
missions.rewardLeftNone: {name} has used all {max} missions today. Missions open again tomorrow.
missions.selectHint: Pick a mission to see its steps.

streetLamp.title: Fix the street lamp
streetLamp.body: The lamp by the east road went dark. Bring the parts to the workshop and fit them in the right order.

steps.title: Pick up parts at the market
steps.hint: Walk to the market stall by the notice board in Central Plaza.

steps.title: Walk to the workshop
steps.hint: Carry the parts to the workshop door in Forge Yard.

steps.title: Fit the parts in order
steps.prompt: Build the lamp from the bottom up: the base plate holds the wire, the wire powers the bulb, and the glass goes over the bulb.

lightsOut.title: Who turned off the lights?
lightsOut.body: Collect clues from the city ledger and the citizens, then name the culprit.

steps.title: Read the city ledger
steps.hint: Walk to the ledger desk in front of the Archive.

steps.title: Ask the night clerk
steps.prompt: The ledger says the lights went out at midnight. What do you ask the night clerk?
options: Who walked past the lamp at midnight?

steps.title: Name the culprit
steps.prompt: The clerk saw a cart hit the lamp post, and the forge cart was out late. Who turned off the lights?

hearthDeliveries.title: Deliveries for Hearth Row
hearthDeliveries.body: Collect the parcels, bring them to the homes and calm an upset neighbour.

steps.title: Collect the parcels
steps.hint: Pick up the parcels on the east side of Central Plaza.

steps.title: Deliver to the homes
steps.hint: Walk the parcels to the homes in Hearth Row.

steps.title: Calm the neighbour
steps.prompt: A neighbour is upset their parcel came late. What do you say?
options: Sorry for the wait. I came as fast as I could, and it is all here.
Take it up with the post office.

nightPatrol.title: Night patrol
nightPatrol.body: Check three posts on the wall and report the one thing out of place.

steps.title: North post
steps.hint: Walk to the north post of Watchtower Gate.

steps.title: East post
steps.hint: Walk along the wall to the east post.

steps.title: Gate post
steps.hint: Finish the round at the post beside the gate.

steps.title: Report what was odd
steps.prompt: Which one did not belong on the wall tonight?
options: A lit torch at the north post
A guard at the east post
An open gate latch at the gate post

ruinsExpedition.title: Expedition to the ruins
ruinsExpedition.body: Pack supplies, cross the gate and map the ruins beyond the wall.

steps.title: Pack supplies
steps.hint: Collect supplies on the south side of Central Plaza.

steps.title: Cross the gate
steps.hint: Walk through the gate into the Outer Frontier.

steps.title: Reach the ruins
steps.hint: Walk to the old ruins deep in the frontier.

steps.title: Map the ruins
steps.prompt: Draw the map from the gate outward: the old road leads from the gate to the broken tower, and the vault lies past the tower.

blackoutNight.title: Blackout Night
blackoutNight.body: Every stat has a job: fix the generator, calm the crowd, find the cause.

steps.title: Fix the generator
steps.prompt: Restart the generator safely: open the fuel first, then start it, and switch the main breaker on last.

steps.title: Calm the crowd
steps.prompt: The plaza is dark and people are worried. What do you say?
options: Stay together, the lights will be back in minutes.

steps.title: Find the cause
options: An overloaded line at the forge

summitTrial.title: The Summit Trial
summitTrial.body: Only a citizen at the top of one stat may enter Summit Hall. Show the council the district can rely on you.

steps.title: Climb to the Hall
steps.hint: Walk up the stairs into Summit Hall.

steps.title: Reach the council table
steps.hint: Walk to the council table at the far end of the Hall.

steps.title: Answer the council
steps.prompt: The council asks what makes a citizen worth following into the next season. What do you answer?
options: Steady work that others can rely on.

steps.title: Seal the charter
steps.prompt: Seal the charter in the right order: read it aloud, sign it, then raise it for the whole district to see.
pieces: Raise it for all to see

missions.stepGoto: Walk {name} to the marker on the map.
missions.stepPuzzle: Tap the pieces in the right order.
missions.cooldownHint: {name} already finished this mission today. It opens again tomorrow.
missions.limitHint: {name} has finished {max} missions today. Come back tomorrow.
missions.citizenBusyHint: {name} is on another mission. Finish or abandon it first.
missions.nextDayHint: Mock only: moves the season clock one day to reset the daily limits.
missions.wrongAnswer: That is not it. Read the question again and pick another reply.
missions.wrongOrder: Wrong order. The pieces were put back, try again.

training.title: TRAINING
training.subtitle: Spend one credit and burn {symbol} to raise one stat by 1
training.speechNoCredit: I need one credit in {stat} first. A mission earns one.
training.head: {stat} {from} → {to}
training.reachesTier: Reaches Tier {tier} and unlocks new content
training.ladderNote: Bar = cost to reach that score. 100 at 1, up to 1,000 at 10.
training.mockNote: Mock mode: nothing is signed or burned. With a wallet this sends one upgrade_score transaction.
training.chainNote: Your wallet signs one transaction that burns the tokens and raises the score on chain. You need a little SOL for the network fee.
training.speechTier: One more {stat} and I reach Tier {tier}. Let's go.
training.speechMaxed: My {stat} is already at the top.
training.notYours: {name} belongs to another player. Pick one of your citizens to train.

season.title: SEASON {number}
season.subtitle: Day {day} of {length} · ends in {left} days
season.entries: {entries} valid entries → up to {winners} cash winners
season.noBoard: The leaderboard for this bracket opens when it has five valid entries.
season.previewOnly: This preview has leaderboard rows for the Skilled bracket only.
season.cutline: CASH PRIZES STOP AT RANK {rank} · ACHIEVEMENT TITLES CONTINUE
season.rules: Points reset each season. Scores, achievements and history stay with the citizen. One wallet enters one citizen per competition.
season.disclosure: Funded only by Pump.fun creator fees under a locked 50 / 30 / 20 split. Prize amounts are not guaranteed. Holding a citizen does not earn rewards.
season.vaultSoon: The vault address appears here once the prize vault is live.
season.explorerMessage: This vault is mock data. The real address appears here after the prize_vault program is deployed.
season.explorerMessageChain: The prize vault is not live yet, so there is no address to show. It appears here once the prize vault program is deployed.

wallet.title: WALLET
wallet.choose: Choose the wallet you want to play with. It asks you to approve the connection.
wallet.none: No Solana wallet was found in this browser. Install one, such as Phantom, Solflare or Backpack, then reload this page.
wallet.network: This game runs on {network}. Set your wallet to the same network before you connect.
wallet.connecting: Waiting for {wallet}. Approve the request in its window.
wallet.signInNote: Missions ask you to sign one short message, so the mission server knows the wallet is yours. Signing it costs nothing.
wallet.declined: The request was closed. Choose a wallet to try again.
wallet.failed: The wallet did not connect. Check that it is unlocked and set to the right network, then try again.

not-owner.title: NOT YOUR CITIZEN
not-owner.message: Only the owner of a citizen can train it or take missions with it.

stat-at-max.title: STAT AT MAXIMUM
stat-at-max.message: This stat is already at 10, the highest score.

no-credit.title: NO CREDIT
no-credit.message: Training needs one credit of the same stat. Finish a mission to earn one.

insufficient-balance.title: NOT ENOUGH TOKENS
insufficient-balance.message: The wallet does not hold enough tokens for this training. Buy more on Pump.fun.

district-locked.title: DISTRICT LOCKED
district-locked.message: This citizen cannot enter that district yet.

mission-busy.title: MISSION TAKEN
mission-busy.message: Another of your citizens is already on this mission.

mission-closed.title: NOT OPEN YET
mission-closed.message: This mission cannot be started yet.

citizen-busy.title: ALREADY ON A MISSION
citizen-busy.message: This citizen is on another mission. Finish or abandon it first.

mission-cooldown.title: DONE TODAY
mission-cooldown.message: This citizen already finished this mission today. It opens again tomorrow.

daily-limit.title: DAILY LIMIT
daily-limit.message: A citizen can finish up to 3 missions per day. Come back tomorrow.

invalid-stat.title: WRONG CREDIT
invalid-stat.message: This mission does not give a credit for that stat.

sold-out.title: SOLD OUT
sold-out.message: Every citizen of this sale has been minted.

wrong-answer.title: NOT QUITE
wrong-answer.message: That is not the right reply. Read the question again and pick another one.

wrong-order.title: WRONG ORDER
wrong-order.message: The pieces do not fit in that order. They were put back, try again.

too-fast.title: TOO FAST
too-fast.message: The step was reported before the walk could be done. Walk to the marker and try again.

season-closed.title: SEASON CLOSED
season-closed.message: Missions are only open while a season is running.

not-connected.title: CONNECT A WALLET
not-connected.message: Connect a wallet to play with your citizens.

claim-pending.title: CLAIM IN PROGRESS
claim-pending.message: The credit for this mission is still being confirmed. Wait a minute and try again.

declined.title: REQUEST CLOSED
declined.message: The wallet request was closed, so nothing was sent. Try again when you are ready.

transaction-failed.title: NOT CONFIRMED
transaction-failed.message: The network did not accept the transaction. Nothing was spent; try again in a moment.

unavailable.title: TRY AGAIN SOON
unavailable.message: The district could not be reached. Nothing was lost; try again in a moment.

insufficient-sol.title: NOT ENOUGH SOL
insufficient-sol.message: The wallet does not hold enough SOL to pay for this.

mint-limit.title: WALLET LIMIT
mint-limit.message: You have reached the citizen limit for this wallet.

mint-not-open.title: MINT NOT OPEN YET
mint-not-open.message: The public mint has not opened yet. Come back at the announced time.

market-closed.title: MARKET NOT OPEN
market-closed.message: The market is not open on this network right now. Nothing was listed or paid.

listing-gone.title: NO LONGER FOR SALE
listing-gone.message: This citizen was sold or taken off the market. Nothing was paid.

price-changed.title: PRICE CHANGED
price-changed.message: The seller changed the price after you opened this listing. Nothing was paid; check the new price and try again.

own-listing.title: YOUR OWN CITIZEN
own-listing.message: You cannot buy a citizen you already own.

already-listed.title: ALREADY FOR SALE
already-listed.message: This citizen is already listed. Change its price from the listing instead.

not-listed.title: NOT FOR SALE
not-listed.message: This citizen has no listing to change.

invalid-price.title: PRICE OUT OF RANGE
invalid-price.message: The price must be between 0.01 SOL and 1,000 SOL.

in-auction.title: AT AUCTION
in-auction.message: This citizen is up for auction. It cannot be listed or sold another way until the auction is finished.

bid-too-low.title: BID TOO LOW
bid-too-low.message: Someone bid in the meantime, or the bid is under the lowest the auction takes. Nothing was paid; check the new bid and try again.

already-highest.title: YOU LEAD ALREADY
already-highest.message: You hold the highest bid on this auction.

auction-ended.title: AUCTION ENDED
auction-ended.message: This auction has ended, so it takes no more bids. Nothing was paid.

auction-live.title: STILL RUNNING
auction-live.message: This auction has not ended yet. It can be finished once the time is up.

auction-has-bids.title: ALREADY BID ON
auction-has-bids.message: Someone has bid, so the auction runs to its end.

actions.walletMessage: This preview uses a mock wallet with mock tokens. Wallet connection arrives with the devnet step.

mint.title: Mint
mint.subtitle: One draw, one NFT
mint.speech: You cannot choose who you get. The mint draws one, and its role stays with the NFT for good.
mint.speechConnect: Connect a wallet to mint. Connecting costs nothing, and you see the price before anything is signed.
mint.speechAfter: Welcome to the district. Earn your first credit in Missions, then train.
mint.soldOutNote: Every citizen of this sale has been minted.
mint.registered: Citizen {code} is now registered in the district.

how.title: The mint draws for you
how.text: There is no list to pick from. The draw is random.

how.title: It is registered at once
how.text: The mint and the citizen record are one transaction, with the starting scores of its role.

how.title: Missions earn, {symbol} trains
how.text: A mission gives a credit. Using it burns {symbol} and raises one stat.

mint.mockNote: Mock mode: nothing is signed or paid. With a wallet, minting and registering the citizen is one transaction.
mint.chainNote: Your wallet signs one transaction: the Candy Machine mint and the citizen record together. If either part fails, nothing is minted and nothing is paid.
mint.limitNote: You have reached the citizen limit for this wallet.

token.text: {symbol} is the official token, launched on Pump.fun. Buy it with your wallet, then burn it to train.
token.testText: {symbol} is the official token, launched on Pump.fun. On devnet it is a test token; the real one is bought on Pump.fun.
token.safe: Training burns it straight from your wallet. Never send it to anyone for training.

welcome.title: WELCOME TO THE DISTRICT
welcome.intro: You play with a citizen of your own. This is the short way in.
welcome.introConnect: Connect a wallet, then mint a citizen to start playing.
welcome.introMint: Mint a citizen to start playing. Missions and training follow from there.

steps.title: Connect your wallet
steps.text: Any Solana wallet works. Connecting costs nothing.

steps.title: Mint your citizen
steps.text: {price} draws one citizen at Tier 0. Its role stays with it for good.

steps.title: Take a mission
steps.text: Missions are free. Each one earns a training credit.

steps.title: Train with {symbol}
steps.text: A credit and {symbol} raise one stat, up to Tier 3.

welcome.browse: Just looking? See the season board

market.title: Market
market.subtitle: Buy and sell citizens
market.emptyFilter: No citizen for sale matches this role.
market.emptyAll: Nothing is for sale right now. Citizens appear here when their owners list them.
market.closedText: The market is not open on this network right now. Until it opens, citizens cannot be listed or bought here.

how.title: A sale is one step
how.text: Payment and transfer happen in one transaction. Both go through, or neither does.

how.title: The citizen moves with its record
how.text: Scores, credits and public history go to the buyer. Private chat memory does not, so the citizen starts fresh with its new owner.

how.title: The royalty is part of the price
how.text: {percent} of each sale goes to the creators of the collection. The seller keeps the rest.

how.title: Or let them bid
how.text: An auction runs for one to three days and the highest bid wins. Anyone who is outbid gets their SOL back at once.

market.yourNone: You do not own a citizen to sell yet.
market.priceInvalid: Enter a price in SOL, for example 0.5.
market.notEnough: Your wallet does not hold enough SOL for this price.
market.mockNote: Mock mode: nothing is signed or paid.
market.buyNoteOne: Payment and transfer happen in one transaction: both go through, or neither does.
market.buyNoteRecord: Scores, credits and public history come with the citizen. Private chat memory does not.
market.sellNoteStay: The citizen stays in your wallet while it is listed. You can still chat, train and take missions with it.
market.sellNoteSale: When someone buys it, the citizen moves to them with its scores, credits and public history. Your private chat memory stays with you.
market.boughtMessage: {name} is now yours. Its scores and public history came with it.
market.listedMessage: {name} is for sale at {price}. It stays with you until someone buys it.
market.soldMessage: {name} was bought for {price}. {amount} reached your wallet after the royalty.
market.previewSale: PREVIEW: LET A BUYER TAKE IT
market.previewSaleHint: Preview only. It shows what a sale leaves behind.
market.emptyAuctions: No citizen is up for auction right now. Owners start auctions from their own citizens.
market.rowAtStart: If it sells at the starting bid
market.auctionNoteFrozen: The citizen stays in your wallet but is frozen until the auction is finished: it cannot be listed, sent or sold anywhere else. You can still chat, train and take missions with it.
market.auctionNoteCancel: You can cancel only until the first bid. After that the auction runs to its end and the highest bid wins.
market.auctionNoteLate: A bid in the last {window} adds {window}, so others get the chance to answer it.
market.testClockNote: Test clock: on this network one auction hour lasts {hour}, so auctions end in minutes.
market.bidNoteHeld: Your bid is held by the market. If someone bids more, it comes back to your wallet in the same moment.
market.bidNoteWin: When the auction ends, anyone can finish it: the citizen moves to the highest bidder and the seller is paid, less the {percent} royalty.
market.mineNoBids: Nobody has bid yet. You can still cancel the auction.
market.mineBids: Someone has bid, so the auction runs to its end.
market.finishNote: This auction has ended. Finishing it moves the citizen to the highest bidder and pays the seller. Anyone can do it.
market.stoppedNote: The seller took back the market's right to move this citizen, so it cannot be delivered. Finishing the auction pays the highest bid back in full.
market.auctionStartedMessage: {name} is up for auction from {price} for {time}. It stays with you, frozen, until the auction is finished.
market.bidPlacedMessage: You lead the auction for {name} at {price}. If someone bids more, your SOL comes back at once.
market.historyNone: No bids yet. Every bid on an auction shows up here, with who placed it and when.
market.historyNoneFilter: No bids on the auctions of this role yet.
market.auctionCancelledMessage: {name} is no longer up for auction and can move freely again.
market.wonMessage: {name} is now yours for {price}. Its scores and public history came with it.
market.noBidMessage: Nobody bid on {name}, so it stays with its owner and can move freely again.
market.finishedMessage: {name} went to the highest bidder for {price}.
market.refundedMessage: {name} could not be delivered, so the highest bid went back to its bidder in full.
market.noticeSold: {name} was sold for {price}. {amount} reached your wallet after the royalty.
market.noticeOutbid: Someone outbid you on {name}. Your {amount} is back in your wallet.
